latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — turn text prompts into AI-generated 1080p videos via API.

- Users can submit up to 50-word product descriptions and receive 1080p MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Automated backend setup: anonymous authentication and session management handled transparently.
- Supports uploads, video editing (audio, overlays, aspect ratio), draft management, and credit checks via chat.
- Provides clear state/status updates and robust error handling, including re-authentication and credit prompts.
- Export options include MP4 and other common formats; max file size 500MB.
- Tips for better results and details about the cloud GPU render pipeline included in documentation.
